location.address: 45 Flame & Spice Avenue, Culinary District, Metro City

reservation_policy.advance_booking: Recommended for dinner and weekends, up to 14 days in advance.
reservation_policy.cancellation: Free cancellation up to 2 hours prior to reservation.
reservation_policy.large_parties: For groups larger than 8, please call concierge directly.

chef_specials_and_pairing.chef_recommendations: Pair rich curries like Tandoori Butter Chicken or Lamb Rogan Josh with Smoked Garlic Butter Naan or Pudina Lachha Paratha. Finish your meal with Warm Saffron Gulab Jamun paired with Cardamom Pistachio Kulfi or Thandai Royale.
